meta.title: Russian to English Voice Translator | IQ Translate
meta.description: Translate Russian to English by voice or text: speak or paste Cyrillic, read and hear the English at once, reply back in Russian. Free, no sign-up.
meta.ogDescription: Speak or paste Russian and get the English meaning in seconds, spoken or written. Reply in English and it goes back in Russian.

hero.title: Russian to English translator
hero.description: You don't need to read Cyrillic to know what was said. Record the sentence or paste the text and the English appears, then answer in English and let it go back in Russian in the same conversation.
hero.mockToPhrase: Could you tell me where the nearest pharmacy is?

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Russian into English.

items.q: Do I need a Cyrillic keyboard?
items.a: No. Speak into the mic or paste the text you were sent — you never have to type Russian yourself.
Yes. Record the sentence and the English transcript appears a couple of seconds after the speaker stops.

items.q: Does it get the grammar right?
items.a: The full sentence is translated at once, so case endings and free word order are resolved instead of producing scrambled word-by-word English.

items.q: Can I reply in English and send Russian?
items.a: Yes, the same conversation runs both ways and the Russian can be read aloud.
Yes, one history per language pair. Even without signing in, this browser is remembered. Clear a pair's history anytime with the trash button above the chat.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.
